abstract: We describe the detection and management of a retroperitoneal dermoid cyst in a young girl. Transabdominal ultrasound revealed in the pelvis a complex mass with anechogenic and echogenic components characteristic of a dermoid cyst. Initially, it was presumed to be of ovarian origin, because extragonadal dermoid cysts are very rare in adolescence; however, the findings on physical examination were normal. Laparoscopy was performed but failed to identify a cyst. Ultrasound examination was repeated intraoperatively and confirmed the presence of the cyst, which was then removed by laparotomy from the retroperitoneum. This case illustrates the significance of ultrasonography in the diagnosis of a rare condition in adolescent gynecology and demonstrates the possibility of performing ultrasound scanning intraoperatively to confirm the presence of a mass which was not identified by laparoscopy.
abstract_ja: 我々は、若年女児の後腹膜類皮嚢腫の検出と管理を報告する。経腹超音波検査で骨盤内に、類皮嚢腫に特徴的な無エコー成分と高エコー成分を併せ持つ複雑な腫瘤が認められた。性腺外類皮嚢腫は思春期にきわめてまれであるため、当初は卵巣由来と考えられた。しかし、身体診察所見は正常であった。腹腔鏡検査を施行したが嚢腫は同定できなかった。術中に超音波検査を再度行い、嚢腫の存在を確認した。その後、開腹により後腹膜から摘出した。本症例は、思春期婦人科領域のまれな疾患の診断における超音波検査の重要性を示すとともに、腹腔鏡では確認できなかった腫瘤を術中超音波で確認できる可能性を示す。
